<a id="unceasing-generation-needs-renewal--不息的生成需要更新"></a>
# Unceasing generation needs renewal

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`unceasing-generation-needs-renewal` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where arising depletes finitely many conditions, unceasing generation needs renewal to recur; renewal does not imply generation.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On a web of dependence, a formation arises across a step when it is inactive at the step and active after it; generation is unceasing when some formation arises at arbitrarily late steps (the same formation may arise again). Arising, becoming active, is the formal carrier of one reading of the second 生 of 生生 (the author's reading). (`Becoming.Web.Arises`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing`)
2. An event depletes a finite family of conditions when, at each of its steps at which no condition of the family rises, one of them falls; this says exactly that some condition of the family changes at each step of the event, whatever its relation to the event. If from some step none of them rises, events depleting the family do not occur at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Web.Rises`, `Becoming.Web.Falls`, `Becoming.Web.Still`, `Becoming.Web.Depletes`, `Becoming.Web.depletes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.stock`, `Becoming.Web.depletion_not_recurring`)
3. Hence, if arising depletes the family, unceasing generation leaves the family still from no step on: that after any step some condition of the family rises (a net rise) cannot be refuted; and if every rise is made by some active formation renewing the condition, renewing activity stops from no step on. (`Becoming.Web.Unceasing.rises`, `Becoming.Web.RenewedBy`, `Becoming.Web.ActiveRenewer`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs`)
4. Balanced flows give a form that needs no net rise: positive uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs the family replenished at arbitrarily late steps; formations taking from the family at their first active step and arising at arbitrarily late steps are one case, in which renewers recur, and a constant consumer with nothing arising is another; in this form arising works only through the uptake it brings. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment`, `Becoming.Flow.ArisesTaking`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake_needs_replenishment`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment_recurs`, `Becoming.Flow.renewing_recurs`, `Becoming.Steady.steady`)
5. A formation lowering some condition of the family at each active step is not active at arbitrarily late steps once none of them rises any more, however it moves its dependence among them: substitution defers the end and does not escape it. (`Becoming.Web.substitution_defers`, `Becoming.Relay.web`, `Becoming.Relay.defers`)
6. If a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it (dissipation), generation is not unceasing; a closed cycle whose total stays constant sustains unceasing generation. (`Becoming.Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Recycle.web`, `Becoming.Recycle.renews`, `Becoming.Recycle.closed_unceasing`)
7. Renewal can recur with nothing arising (a tide the moon renews), so under these premises unceasing generation is strictly stronger than recurring renewal. (`Becoming.Tide.web`, `Becoming.Tide.renews`, `Becoming.Tide.renewal_without_arising`)
8. Formations can arise one after another while drawing an unrenewed condition, consume it, and arising does not recur; a consumer can move from one source to another and end. (`Becoming.Growth.web`, `Becoming.Growth.ceases`, `Becoming.Relay.defers`)
9. A formation arising again and again on a condition the source renews meets every premise and generation is unceasing; the stepwise working candidate withholds each of its arisings, and the reading over cycles of two includes it. (`Becoming.Oscillation.web`, `Becoming.Oscillation.renews`, `Becoming.Oscillation.unceasing`, `Becoming.Oscillation.readings`)
10. The flow form holds in every world with the local condition inside the law: balance on the family only from some step on; the forms with balance everywhere are their corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.uptake_needs_replenishment_from`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment_recurs_from`, `Becoming.Flow.renewing_recurs_from`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The family of conditions is a finite list; levels and amounts in flows are natural numbers.
- The depletion premise: at a step where no condition of the family rises, each arising lowers one of them. It asks only that some condition of the family change and does not involve the arising formation (Tide); it is a correspondence premise, not a conclusion.
- Renewal is made by formations (RenewedBy): every rise is made by some active formation renewing the condition, with no source of renewal outside the unfolding; a sun or a river is one of its formations. renews is an observable supplied by the application, and the conclusion is only as strong as it.
- The flow form (uptake_needs_replenishment, replenishment_recurs, renewing_recurs): the flow balances the web, and uptake is positive at arbitrarily late steps, or formations taking from the family at their first active step (ArisesTaking) arise at arbitrarily late steps.
- Dissipation (dissipation_arising_not_recurring): a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it. A family's total level is such a quantity only when every arising lowers it, and the total presupposes commensurable units. For a quantity every arising dissipates, free energy for instance, this is a physical premise.
- “Unceasing” reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps, not “more”, diversity or complexity.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Yields no “unceasing is better” or any ranking.
- Does not state “more”, diversity or complexity; the generation component is not added to any reading of living.
- The depletion premise asks only that some condition of the family change (depletes_iff) and does not screen out arisings made by naming (TideFlip). Witness: `Becoming.TideFlip.naming_meets_premises`.
- In the flow form of the two-kind reading arising works only through uptake (Steady), while the arising of an embodied relatum is itself replenishment (generation-is-replenishment). Witness: `Becoming.Steady.steady`.
- Unceasing depends on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): a naming that keeps continuing activity makes no arising, and reading the theorems as about generation needs such a naming.
- Rises is a net rise, and concurrent replenishment is visible only in the flow form. Witness: `Becoming.Expansion.undepleted`.
- The witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** Renewal does not imply generation (Tide.renewal_without_arising): a tide the moon renews rises at arbitrarily late steps and the moon's renewing recurs while nothing arises; this is strictness in this result's own sense. The `Renewable` witness (Renewable.renewal_without_arising) is “dependence kept, no arising”, with no rise. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The depletion premise does not involve the arising formation (Tide.unrelated_depletion): a flicker that depends and draws on nothing arises at every odd step, each time meeting the premise through the unrelated fall of a tide, and every premise holds. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The positive witness meets the depletion premise only vacuously (Oscillation.arises_on_rise): the oscillator arises only when the source has restored its condition, at a rise, and draws at the next step. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without dissipation a closed finite family can be unceasing (Recycle.closed_unceasing): one unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise holds and generation is unceasing; dissipation_arising_not_recurring needs every arising to lower the quantity concerned. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A net rise cannot see concurrent replenishment (Expansion.undepleted): in the expansion renewers and growers arise at every step, the level never rises, and the depletion premise fails; the flow form replenishment_recurs applies (Expansion.growers_take). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The flow form does not need arising (Steady.steady): a consumer and a renewer are always active, the flow balances, uptake is positive at every step and nothing arises, and replenishment is still needed at arbitrarily late steps; what needs it is the recurring uptake. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Arisings made by naming meet every premise (TideFlip.naming_meets_premises): the tide and the moon with nothing arising, their names exchanged at every odd step, give unceasing generation with Depletes and RenewedBy; the conclusion concerns conditions only and holds, while the generation is the naming's. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Arising one after another does not certify unceasing generation (Growth.ceases): formations arise while drawing an unrenewed condition, and arising on a consumed condition does not recur. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The stepwise reading and generation come apart (Oscillation.readings): a formation arising again and again (the oscillator) has no living arising under the stepwise working candidate; the reading over cycles of two includes it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; the definition now named Depletes did not involve the arising formation, the cited strictness witness had no rise, “no finite part is unceasing on its own” needs dissipation, “the second 生 of 生生” and “generation by consumption” were not labelled as the author's reading, and the vocabulary of exchange conflicted with Ren's corrections (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P9B-P10-P11-REVIEW.md)
- **Counterexample:** An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; the flow form uses only the uptake arising brings, and a rebuttal in the integration note was stronger than the theorem; naming-made arisings can meet every premise; unceasing generation depends on identity, which this record did not note (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). This result formalizes only “unceasingly … 生” and states it on the whole's continuation, which is the author's reading; on Ren's delegation the second 生 is further generation, what can form together with the conditions and generators of further forming, and arising on depletion is classed by the comparison, which reads what can form (DELEGATED-CHOICES D3, revised by its place in one account, D45). Under these premises, arising borne by unrenewed conditions cannot be unceasing; at the level of continuation this accords with Ren's statement that generation and degeneration do not overlap (the author's reading), while at the level of single events Arises includes arising on a consumed condition. So the result supports the source's AI correction note that the “持续” of “持续形成新组织” already excludes the consuming type; it does not show that every non-consuming pattern can be unceasing. The author further interprets: under dissipation no finite part is unceasing on its own, and unceasing generation belongs to a larger unfolding (an AI argument; for taking in flows, no-finite-part-bears-taking proves it under the dissipation premise). Whether actual unfoldings meet the depletion premise, RenewedBy, the flow correspondence and dissipation is an empirical question. The new names are the reviewer's suggestions, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).
